source_evidence: Exact player 'Leave and relay the info, the. go find the route broker'. Routine exit/briefing and actual reachable contact from established dispatch reference. Broker ordinary presence is newly played scene adjudication, not a preplanned patron meeting or new transaction. No new V pledge or disclosure to broker. D326~17:15 Orsaven counting shop about200ft uphill from storehouse1, V at ordinary public counter, Cirren/Fenar just outside in public street by their own agreement, Mara safely at Copper Hart with coach/four horses. Exact player 'Leave and relay the info, the. go find the route broker' authorizes leaving warehouse, briefing companions on actually acquired evidence/knowledge, and ordinary search/contact at known address; no document surrender, new cover speech beyond routine inquiry, threats, payment, magic, or private-room entry. V exits via unlocked rear service door in still-accepted worker apron/cap, no new uncertain obstruction or alert, no need to reroll disguise or stealth for routine exit under existing successful Deception20; accountant's discovery of missing acknowledgement not observed, no permanent ignorance assumed. V reunites with Cirren/Fenar and shares actual witnessed documents, fee-book entries and clerk directions. Retains both original lot27 invoice and delegate sealed acknowledgement. Cirren understands actual recorded payments D320 6gp, D323 8gp, 14gp total and broker reimbursement column, political petition/exemption language, evidence limitations. Fenar aware of actual findings. Party walks200ft uphill; shopkeeper recognizes joint freight account and confirms the route broker is present for ordinary end-of-day correspondence/accounts, not an arranged private patron meeting or new criminal event. Shopkeeper calls him down to public shop counter; broker (SYN-BROKER) appears from upper stair, no new proper name assigned; newly adjudicated actual ordinary availability consistent with existing correspondence address and fixed role. Broker personally knows route arrangements and his own correspondence/payments, seeks predictable commerce and avoids violence that closes quays; does not automatically recognize V or know warehouse entry/theft, no awareness of private Watch investigation or Quenwood murder evidence. He sees V's worker apron/cap and asks what business V has. Cirren/Fenar stay nearby on street, not concealed inside, link still active until23:05 within1mile; no further V dialogue or actual presentation of documents to broker yet. No active meeting, patron/legate appearance, signed investment, new faction deployment, combat, check or expenditure. Retained fixed prep dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4: two60x40ft storehouses150ft apart, upper rented40x25ft room above shop with public and rear service stair; finite roles/resources unchanged. No claim current private upper room has particular documents/persons besides broker's actual ordinary presence before descending. V original invoice: 'RIVERSIDE STOREHOUSE No. 2 — Received in full: 36 gp. One case fine imported lace. Lot 27, transferred from Storehouse No. 1. For the joint freight account: paid.' Sealed original acknowledgement: 'Received fourteen gold pieces for information supplied concerning the forthcoming berth inspections. I shall continue to represent your interests in the matter of selective inspection exemptions.' Title and personal seal commercial petition delegate, stylized signature unread as name. Prior fee book and loose payment sheet remain in accountant custody. Clerk identified correspondence route through broker, not name of delegate, no promise/defection. Witnessed ferry/lighter transfer, receiver's discreet purse to landing official, warehouse payment and tracked lace sale; no proven involvement of current organization in Quenwood's murders. Paymaster holds recorded48gp for restitution, promised notification not verified, no recovery paid. Quenwood life sentence upheld, assets frozen. Skiff rescued and Meret referral delivered, no business transaction. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi3/6 MP6/7 PastLife2/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers0/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Mara and animals healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR0/6, no rest/spending. Royal recommendation and Crown decision pending; Kestrel copies confidential complete originals retained; separate frontier commission300+1300 contingent. Conditional western service-house grant signed not title, Coris packet300 pending optional800 field. Commissions520 due target353 actual completion pending. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Await V response to route broker, no automatic further action.
